Admin routes of the checkout module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/checkout/settings

Get checkout settings

Responses:

- `200`: Settings retrieved.

## PATCH /v1/admin/checkout/settings

Update checkout settings

Request body: [UpdateCheckoutSettingsDto](#updatecheckoutsettingsdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Settings updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.

## Schemas

### UpdateCheckoutSettingsDto

- `guestCheckoutEnabled` (boolean, optional).
- `requiredFields` (`"email"`, `"phone"`, `"shippingAddress"`, `"billingAddress"`, `"company"`, `"note"`, optional).
- `termsOfServiceUrl` (string, max length 500, nullable, optional).
- `postPurchaseRedirectUrl` (string, max length 500, nullable, optional).
- `checkoutMessage` (string, max length 500, nullable, optional).
